text: Thirteen-year-old Valerie wakes to find her earrings stolen, and a masked man called the Constable begins to watch her through a small town of priests, missionaries and players. Her grandmother Elsa, still aching for the man who abandoned her, [bargains away the house for her lost youth|wants|cheating death and age] and [bites a bride on her wedding night|threat|blood drinkers]. Valerie keeps herself safe with [a pearl and a pair of magic earrings|rules|faith and charms protect] as the week drifts [from one dream into the next|ending|it was never real].
